audit.why: HARD 8/10 is right for lane — a 600 in-and-out dash and a 925 chain against an immobile mage — while 53.01% over 2311 games reflects Lux taking over once a root kills a no-sustain assassin.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[4..6].side all read 'LeBlanc' while content win[4..6] and the packet read Skill/Lux/Lux, and the whys under rows 5 and 6 already described Lux winning.
audit.why: Level 6 is genuinely skill-decided (Mimic burst versus a banked root) and from Luden's onward one landed Light Binding kills a champion with no sustain.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Skill, phases[5..6].side -> Lux, with every why rewritten to argue its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive mechanics were absent: Ethereal Chains only roots after the target stays shackled 1.5 seconds, Sigil of Malice marks for 3.5s and detonates off any follow-up ability, and Mirror Image makes her invisible for 1 second below 40% health and leaves a damageless clone.
audit.why: Straight from Riot's text for E, Q and the passive.
audit.corrected: The 1.5s shackle window is now in the cooldown field, the 3.5s sigil mark is in the Don'ts, and the clone is named as the reason not to greed a detonation at low HP.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fifteen fields used he/his for LeBlanc; two bullets repeated the trade lines under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists leblanc as female; lintFindings names both bleeds.
audit.corrected: All rewritten in she/her with bodies matching their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: lint UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: "doubles her combo" asserted a ratio with no number behind it.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: phases[4].why.

edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Prismatic Barrier has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Distortion: 15s at rank 1 down to 10s, with a 4-second window to return — punish the landing spot. - Sigil of Malice: 6s, and it refunds if the mark kills. - Ethereal Chains: 14s to 11s, and it needs 1.5s shackled before the root lands. - Mimic: 45s at rank 1, 25s at rank 3.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry by making her spend Distortion first — one binding banked, then Q-E-R onto a LeBlanc with no sustain and nowhere left to dash.

edits.before: Bank Q exclusively for his engage
edits.after: Bank Q exclusively for her engage

edits.before: Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Distortion is a 600 dash with a 4-second return, 15s at rank 1 — once she spends the return charge she is stranded. Go then.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Distortion covers 600 and back again — a centered wave and warded flanks mean she cannot open from fog, and 15s is a long walk home.

edits.after: Q-poke near her engage timers

edits.before: Your W answers exactly one combo per fight — shield the spell that kills, not the one that stings.

notes: dosFull[2].d's 'fifteen-second invitation' happens to be accurate here — Distortion is 15s at rank 1 — so I left it. Ratings on phases[4..6] were left at 7/10; as with the other Lux matchups the rating scale reads as overall difficulty, not per-row ownership, so I moved only side and why. win[4..6] needed no edit: the content layer already matched the packet and the full layer was the one out of step. QA re-scope: previous edits to phases[4].why were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
